message.content:
<summary>
Turn 1: Agent listed /root and /root/DATA contents; read /root/question.txt showing 3 questions (q1 about CoachForce Market Research Report authors + key reviewers employee IDs; q2 about employee IDs of team members giving strengths/weaknesses insights on PersonalizeForce competitor products; q3 about demo URLs shared for PersonalizeForce competitor products).

Turns 2–4: Agent attempted to iterate over all product JSONs with a Python loop to preview keys; command hung (soft timeout) and was interrupted with Ctrl-C.

Turn 5: Listed product JSON files and sizes (~26MB total). Tried to use ripgrep (rg) to search, but rg not installed (command not found).

Turn 6: Used grep instead to find “Market Research Report” occurrences across product JSONs; confirmed CoachForce.json contains Market Research Report references and has an embedded meeting transcript with attendee names.

Turn 7: Parsed /root/DATA/products/CoachForce.json recursively for objects with type/document_type == “Market Research Report”; found 4 items:
- /documents[0] id=cofoaix_market_research_report author=eid_890654c4 date=2026-04-09
- /documents[1] id=final_cofoaix_market_research_report author=eid_890654c4 date=2026-04-12
- /documents[2] id=latest_cofoaix_market_research_report author=eid_890654c4 date=2026-04-19
- /meeting_transcripts[0] id=CoFoAIX_planning_1 document_type=Market Research Report

Turn 8: Inspected /root/DATA/metadata; found employee.json, salesforce_team.json, customers_data.json.

Turns 9–10: Checked feedback fields in CoachForce Market Research Report docs: first doc has no feedback; final/latest docs have feedback as a string. Printed latest feedback: bullet list of suggested improvements, but no explicit key reviewer IDs there.

Turns 11–13: Explored employee.json; initial assumption it was a list failed (KeyError). Determined employee.json is a dict keyed by employee id (e.g., “eid_...”) mapping to records containing name, etc. Built name->list-of-eids mapping for several names from the transcript; many names map to multiple possible eids (ambiguous).

Turn 14: Pulled participants from CoachForce meeting transcript CoFoAIX_planning_1: participants are ['eid_99835861','eid_50da4819','eid_ee9ca887','eid_8df92d08','eid_85a4de81','eid_965867b8','eid_59bbe6f6'].

Turn 15: Began work on PersonalizeForce.json; printed top-level keys: ['slack','documents','meeting_transcripts','meeting_chats','urls','prs']; documents is a list of 10; meeting_transcripts is a list of 8. (No extraction yet for q2/q3 in this window.)
</summary>
